messages:
Alex (AE): Quick heads-up — NovaHealth wants an alternate billing schedule for POC->paid. They want 30% upfront for the POC, then 8 quarterly invoices for the remaining first-year commitment, and are requesting Net60 on each invoice. They also asked about a 10% prepay discount for full-year payment. Can Deal Desk + Finance advise next steps?

Ryan (Solutions): From technical/POC side — we can gate full traffic until the POC invoice clears. Need to confirm expected token volume so we can cap overages.

Emma (Finance): Net60 on all invoices is non-standard. We'll need a credit check and VP Finance approval for >$250k AR exposure. What's the contract value and term?

Alex (AE): 1yr commit, $480,000 ARR. POC value is ~$20k but customer proposes 30% of total upfront (which would be $144k) then 8 quarterly invoices for the balance. Sample schedule below:

```
Invoice 1 (POC): 30% = $144,000 due on signing (customer requests Net60)
Invoice 2..9: 8x quarterly = $42,000 each due Net60
Prepay option: single invoice with 10% discount -> $432,000 due on signing
```

Jordan (Legal): We'll need a payment addendum: explicit net terms, default interest, and a clause that allows us to pause service on missed payments. Also require PO reference and invoice remittance instructions. If Net60 accepted, add accelerated payment clause on upgrade/termination.

Emma (Finance): Conditional sign-off: we can allow Net60 on the remaining invoices only if: (1) credit check passes, (2) customer provides a PO, and (3) VP Finance approves exposure >$250k. Prepay option with 10% discount is fully approvable by Finance (lower risk).

DealDesk Bot: Submitted deal desk ticket DD-2026-331 — https://redwood.internal/deals/DD-2026-331. Status: awaiting finance review.

Oliver (VP Finance): For $480k exposure I'd prefer at least 30% upfront (POC ok) and Net30 thereafter. If customer insists on Net60, require a corporate guarantee or a shorter billing cadence. Also require ACH/lockbox terms.

Ryan (Solutions): Technical mitigation: we can set hard token caps and automatic throttling until second invoice clears; can also enforce a usage hold and allow manual override by Finance.

Alex (AE): Customer pushed back: they will only sign if Net60 on all invoices. I'll offer two options: (A) Full-year prepay with 10% discount, or (B) 30% upfront + Net30 quarterly (preferred by Finance). If they still want Net60, request credit references and accept conditional approval.

Emma (Finance): Action items — 1) Finance to run credit check (Emma) 2) Legal to draft payment addendum & late fee language (Jordan) 3) Deal Desk to present the two approved options and capture customer's PO + AP contact (DealDesk Bot). I'll queue VP review if credit check passes.

Jordan (Legal): I'll draft an addendum template and post in this thread for review.

DealDesk Bot: DD-2026-331 updated: status -> awaiting VP Finance approval. Attachments: customer_PO_54321.pdf (uploaded).

Alex (AE): Thanks all — I'll push prepay first (option A) and report back. :pray:
